layers.name: CLI / Entry Point
layers.description: Command-line interface and main orchestration. Parses args, initializes distributed training, loads ONNX model, drives the quantization pipeline.

layers.name: Graph Utilities (ONNX Manipulation)
layers.description: Core ONNX graph abstraction. Provides ONNXGraph class for node/tensor/initializer manipulation, topological ordering, shape inference, quantization helpers, serialization, and dataset utilities.

layers.name: Distributed Training
layers.description: Multi-GPU / multi-node coordination wrappers for MPI and SLURM environments.

layers.name: Platform Configuration
layers.description: Central registry mapping deploy target (trt, snpe, qnn, rv, magicmind, ti, imx, atlas, stpu) to quantization parameters: bit-widths, symmetric/asymmetric mode, per-channel/per-tensor settings, which layers to quantize, and deploy-specific flags.

layers.name: Tensor Calibration (Activation Quantization)
layers.description: Collects activation ranges from calibration data via ONNXRuntime forward passes. Implements three calibration algorithms: MinMax, Histogram (with KL thresholding), and MSE (OCTAV). Includes weight-only minmax clipping.

layers.name: Forward Network (ONNXRuntime Inference Engine)
layers.description: ONNXRuntime-based inference for calibration data collection. Provides per-subnet caching for transformer models (ActivationCache) and standalone forward functions for classic models.

layers.name: Quantization (Graph Rewriting)
layers.description: Injects Q/DQ (QuantizeLinear/DequantizeLinear) fake-quantization nodes into the ONNX graph, setting up scale/zero-point tensors. Supports per-channel and per-tensor quantization, symmetric and asymmetric modes, and channel-last transpose for ConvTranspose.

layers.name: Weight Transformation
layers.description: Post-calibration weight transformations that improve quantized model accuracy. Includes BiasCorrection, WeightEqualization, Adaround, BrecQ/QDrop, sparse quantization, and BN update. Orchestrated by weight_calibration in weight_trans_base.py.

sub_modules.adaround: Activation-based range optimization for weight rounding
sub_modules.brecq: Bit-level reconstruction; QDrop adds stochastic drop

layers.name: Profiling (Quantization Error Analysis)
layers.description: Layer-wise and model-wise quantization error profiling using cosine similarity and max-abs-gap metrics. Supports multipass and transformer architectures. Outputs per-layer and aggregated profiling JSON.

layers.name: Deployment (Platform-Specific Export)
layers.description: Writes quantized model and range files in target accelerator's format. Base dispatcher routes to platform-specific generators for TensorRT, SNPE, QNN, RV, MagicMind, TI, IMX, Atlas, STPU. Each deploy_*.py registers with the dispatcher and writes config blobs.

layers.name: Shared Utilities
layers.description: Dataset loading (binary files) and calibration-data batch generation used across calibration and profiling.

flow: tensor_calibration() collects activation ranges (forward_net via ONNXRuntime)
weight_calibration() applies transforms: bc → we → update_bn → adaround/brecq/sparse
to_deploy() routes to platform-specific deploy_*.py writer
data_flow: clip_val + ONNX graph → quantize.py → quantized ONNX with QDQ nodes
quantized graph + clip_val → deploy_*.py → platform-specific config
